messages:
jordan: Heads up — customer ACME reported invoice 2026-03-01 higher than SDK local estimator by ~120 tokens. They claim SDK reported 1,020 tokens but invoice shows 1,140.

 taylor: any chance this is the usual system/tool prefill? did they use function calling? :thinking:

 jordan: They sent a chat with system msg + user prompt + a tool call. Our local SDK estimator logs:
```
estimate: prompt_tokens=420, completion_tokens=600, total=1020
sdk_version: 2.4.1
```
But the invoice line item shows 1,140 tokens. Attached server metering ID: metering_zt8k6, request_id: req_0a1b2c3d

 nina: can you paste the full request payload (redact PII)? sometimes a system assistant message or tool output is added by the sidecar

 jordan: pasted payload:
```
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}], "functions": [{"name":"search_docs","arguments":{}}], streaming: false}
```

 sam: quick check — did they stream and then reconnect? stream resume can duplicate trailing tokens in invoice while SDK estimator stops earlier.

 jordan: customer says no streaming. They did a function call and the function returned some metadata logs. SDK doesn't fetch function result when estimating (we thought). billing-bot: Invoice lines include server-inserted tool metadata tokens when function_result is attached to final response.

 taylor: ok hypothesis: server appended function result with kv-prefill metadata (like "__tool_meta__": "trace..."). That could be ~120 tokens. Can we repro with server-side simulation?

 nina: repro steps I ran:
1) curl to /v1/chat/completions with same messages + functions
2) server returned function call and then final assistant message with function_result attached
3) meter reported tokens: prompt=420, assistant_output=720, total=1140

 curl I used:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize..."}],"functions":[{"name":"search_docs"}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

 jordan: interesting — so SDK estimator earlier purposely ignored server-attached function_result tokens. That's the delta.

 taylor: action items:
- nina: add a reproducible test to estimator repo that simulates function_result attachment and counts tokens like meter. (ETA 24h)
- sam: confirm docs about estimator limitations and add note to support KB. (ETA 48h)
- billing-bot: flag invoice metering_zt8k6 for review and attach this thread.

 billing-bot: flagged invoice metering_zt8k6 for manual audit — assigned to @sam.

 sam: assigned. I'll audit the raw metering events and post a short summary. If confirmed, we should issue customer credit for the unexpected prefills and update estimator behavior.

 jordan: customer wants quick explanation to avoid churn. I'll send a brief note: "We discovered server-attached tool metadata was included in the invoice but not in your local SDK estimator; we're auditing and will credit any unexpected charges." :+1:

 nina: fyi I pushed a tiny patch to sdk-estimator to fetch the hypothetical function_result size when function_call present; PR #582

 taylor: great. once Nina's PR merges, can we run the customer's payload and show the new estimate matches invoice? if so, credit + follow-up.

 jordan: will coordinate. thanks team.
